technique_name: Design an experiment to test the ability of GPT models to natural language understanding.
description: The experiment should involve giving GPT models a set of natural language tasks and evaluating their performance. These tasks can involve classification, open-ended generation, comprehension, and editing. The tasks should involve a mix of short-answer and essay-style questions with varying levels of complexity.
